Here's a description of the line plot, following your instructions:

The plot presents training curves, illustrating the change in accuracy over a series of epochs for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 400 with tick labels at every 50 units. The y-axis is labeled "Training Accuracy" and is also linear, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.2 units. A purple line with a triangular marker and solid style represents "C³Aₙ=128/2". This line begins at 0.22 at epoch 0 and fluctuates, reaching a peak of 0.87 at epoch 65, then a minimum of 0.22 at epoch 70, before generally increasing to a value of 0.77 at epoch 400. A blue line with a circular marker and solid style represents "LoRAₘ=1".  This line starts at 0.22 at epoch 0, fluctuates, reaches a peak of 0.87 at epoch 65, before generally increasing to a value of 0.84 at epoch 400. A dark grey line with a square marker and solid style represents "Linear". This line begins at 0.51 at epoch 0, and increases, reaching a value of 0.63 at epoch 100, then 0.74 at epoch 200, before the training plateaus and reaching 0.75 at epoch 400.
